purpose: Teach: ヨーグルト/ミシン/見合い/白黒/なかでも/慰め/日ごろ/ちまっ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、朝食、ヨーグルト、最近、よく食べてるよ、私、健康のため。
lines.en: Hey Riku — I've been eating a lot of yogurt for breakfast lately, you know, for my health.
lines.style: Bright, easy confidence. Quick delivery like she's testing his reaction. Light, conspiratorial tone — sharing something slightly goofy without self-consciousness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。家庭科の授業で、ミシン、初めて、ちゃんと使えたぜ、俺。
lines.en: Yeah. Actually nailed using the sewing machine properly for the first time in home-ec class.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Slight lift on 「ちゃんと使えた」 — modest surprise at his own competence. Cool exterior but the pride leaks through.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うちの両親、お見合い結婚なんだって、ちょっと、驚いたよ、最近、知った。
lines.en: My parents got married through an arranged match, apparently. I only found out recently — kind of threw me.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause at the start. Slow, gentle delivery like she's still processing it. Slight wonder in the voice — not shock, but genuine recalibration.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 昔の卒業アルバム、白黒で、お父さんが映ってたよ、面白い。
lines.en: There's this old yearbook photo of my dad in black and white. Honestly kind of hilarious.
lines.style: Wry, small smile in the voice. Dry amusement — not loud laughter, just the steady recognition of something genuinely funny about the past.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部活、なかでも、合宿が、一番、思い出に残るんだよね、楽しかった。
lines.en: It's the club camp trips that stick with me the most, honestly. Those were really good times.
lines.style: Warm, a little wistful. Softens on the memory. Slower pace — savoring the moment rather than rushing through it. Genuine nostalgia.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の慰めの言葉、結構、効いてるぜ、桜、ありがとうな。
lines.en: Your words actually helped me more than you know, Riku. Thank you.
lines.style: Sincere, unguarded. No performance. Quiet steadiness — saying something she means without fanfare. Slight vulnerability in the openness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 日ごろの練習、お前、頑張ってるよね、リク、応援してる、いつも。
lines.en: You put in real work on your practice, you know. I'm always rooting for you.
lines.style: Soft, genuine support. Slow, intentional delivery — each word carries weight. Not exuberant, but deeply steady. The reassurance of someone who pays attention.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 小学校の写真、お前、めっちゃ、ちまっこかったよな、可愛かったぜ。
lines.en: You were absolutely tiny in your elementary school photos. Actually kind of adorable.
lines.style: Gentle, amused affection. Slight tease underneath but genuine warmth. Wry smile — the specific humor of watching someone grow, vulnerability glimpsed in an old photo.
